title: Shared information.
description: See what you've shared and manage future access.
emptyDescription: Every share starts with your choice and confirmation.
sessionNotice: These are sharing simulations from this session. No information was sent. Records clear when the app reloads or you confirm a session reset or leave the demo.
revokeDescription: This removes the selected demo share from this session. No real access is changed. Source wellness data and saved information stay unchanged.
revokedNotice: Demo access revoked. The selected share has been removed.
previewNotice: This confirms a demo action only. Recipient-sharing confirmations appear in Shared Information for this session. Export previews are not recorded there. No information is sent.
